schema_and_control_donor.role: RBDSeries/RBDSeriesStructure native JSON column schema and accepted all-series contrast

source.rule: MissionOperationalModes maps each mission type/system pair to an operational mode. MaterielOperationalModes maps that mode to an RBD; the same aircraft may therefore use a series block for one mission type and a parallel block for another.

configuration.accepted_controls: G04 v1.0.1 series and parallel controls use one aircraft on three h8/h20/h32 two-hour missions and matched POS-B/POS-B/POS-A seeded failures at h8.62763/h20.8222/h33.0996. All-series is critical/abort three times; all-parallel is noncritical/success three times.
configuration.mixed: Keep the accepted parallel physical B/A failure inputs, direct half-hour CM, one aircraft, seed1/replication1/horizon36. BASIC-MISSION at h8 and h32 selects new G09-SER-OPS -> G09-SER-RBD requiring POS-A and POS-B; new PAR-MISSION at h20 selects inherited G04-OPS -> G04-PARALLEL requiring one of A/B. Both mission types have the same two-hour schedule parameters and usage rate1.

pre_run_hypotheses: Native import/export preserves all populated authored tables including two mission type-to-system-mode rows and both RBDs; calculation has zero errors or unreviewed diagnostics and produces nonempty SXO/event log/report.

The mixed schedule produces a POS-B failure in a series-mode mission and a POS-B failure in a parallel-mode mission; native criticality/mission outcome differs between those mission types and aligns with accepted controls. Exact event times are empirical and are not assumed to share a stochastic draw merely because the seed is fixed.
The third BASIC-MISSION helps verify the series mapping is reused after the parallel mission. Reports reconcile per-mission outcomes, failure/repair counts, no stock movement and terminal readiness.
native_acceptance: One unique guarded session-0 SSH native run with host-wide mutex, GUI PID13340 identity, registry restoration, frozen source/control fingerprints and raw SHA-256 seals.
Exact populated-table roundtrip, zero converter errors, reviewed warnings, nonempty SXO/event log/report and 72-bin System/Stock reconciliation.
Independent read-only replay comparing mixed outcome to accepted G04 series/parallel controls without overclaiming common random draws.
diagnostic_gate: If the mixed schedule does not expose both mission-type responses to the same physical B fault, retain this run as diagnostic and revise with a new version/run ID; do not weaken the frozen hypothesis.
limits: One aircraft, two mission types, three scheduled missions, one seed/replication and two-position series/active parallel RBDs; other mission patterns, mode defaults and noncritical-set/USERT effects are untested.
Mission-specific RBD selection is inferred from frozen mapping plus native criticality; event logs may not print the selected RBID. No GUI drawing, population reliability or cross-engine claim.
